title: UTM campaign measurement
description: Consistent UTM tags on inbound links, checked against the analytics report before launch.

sources.title: Google Analytics Help, Collect campaign data with custom URLs

rules.instruction: Ask the analytics owner for the agreed source, medium and campaign values, and use them in the same case on every link tagged with UTM parameters.
rules.verification: Open a sample link for each channel, follow redirects and check that a test visit appears under the expected campaign dimensions.

rules.instruction: Keep personal data, such as email addresses, names or customer identifiers, out of UTM parameter values.
rules.verification: Review the tagged links in the campaign plan and confirm that no parameter value contains personal data.
